Subject: CloudSource discovery — recap + proposed pilot next steps

Hi Emma — great to meet today, thank you for the time. Quick recap from our discovery and the concrete next steps we discussed: 

- Primary goal: reduce inference cost for search-ranking reranks and cut 95th%-tile latency from ~420ms to target <200ms for peak traffic.
- Current infra: internal TF model with KV-cache constraints; prefer rolling proof-of-concept rather than full migration.
- Security: need SOC2 evidence + network isolation for pilot (you mentioned legal/security will review).

Proposed pilot (timeline we suggested):
1) Pilot scope: 2-week performance and correctness run against 50k daily requests (staging)
2) Deliverables: perf report, token-cost projection, quantization profile recommendations
3) Kickoff target: week of Dec 7 (aim to land before EoQ decision window)

As discussed, attached is a short evaluation plan and a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and owners. Action items / ask for you:
- Can you confirm the E2E decision date your team is targeting (you mentioned EoQ but wanted to double-check whether that is firm)?
- Who will own procurement/PO and security sign-off on your side (name + email)?
- If the timeline is tight, we can compress the pilot and provide interim results sooner.

I'll follow up to get a slot on the calendar for a 15-min alignment call if that helps move internal approvals along.

Thanks — Marissa

Would appreciate a quick reply or a 15-minute sync — happy to take a slot on Thursday or Friday. Also re-attaching the evaluation plan and MAP for convenience.
